targets.rawSql: SELECT repository as "Repository" FROM v_repository_names WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT total_commits as "Total Commits" FROM v_repository_summary WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT total_prs as "Total PRs" FROM v_repository_summary WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT contributors as "Contributors" FROM v_repo_total_contributors WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT count as "Active Contributors" FROM v_active_contributors_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT count as "Open PRs" FROM v_open_prs WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT time, commits FROM v_repo_commits_daily_trend_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY time;
SELECT time, added, removed FROM v_repo_lines_changed_daily_trend_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY time;
SELECT contributor, commits FROM v_repo_top_contributors_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY commits DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT reviewer, reviews FROM v_repo_top_reviewers_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY reviews DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT status, count FROM v_repo_pr_status_distribution WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT size_category, count FROM v_repo_pr_size_distribution_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT time, created FROM v_repo_pr_creation_daily_trend_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY time;
SELECT time, merged FROM v_repo_pr_merge_daily_trend_30d WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY time;
SELECT days_to_merge as "Days to Merge" FROM v_repo_pr_health_summary WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT prs_with_issues as "PRs with Issues" FROM v_repo_pr_health_summary WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT avg_comments as "Avg Comments" FROM v_repo_pr_health_summary WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';
SELECT avg_approvals as "Avg Approvals" FROM v_repo_pr_health_summary WHERE repo_id = '${repository}';

SELECT time, critical, high, medium, low
FROM v_repo_code_quality_trend_90d
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY time;

SELECT time, coverage
FROM v_repo_code_quality_trend_90d
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY time;

SELECT time, debt
FROM v_repo_code_quality_trend_90d
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY time;

SELECT severity, count
FROM v_repo_vulnerabilities_by_severity_latest
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY 
  CASE severity 
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 
  END;

SELECT 
  package_name as "Package",
  version as "Version",
  cve_id as "CVE",
  severity as "Severity",
  summary as "Summary",
  fixed_in_version as "Fixed In",
  published_date as "Published"
FROM v_repo_vulnerability_details_latest
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY 
  CASE severity 
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 
  END,
  published_date DESC;

SELECT 
  branch_name,
  staleness_days as "Days Inactive"
FROM v_branch_metrics_latest
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND is_active = true
ORDER BY staleness_days DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
  branch_name,
  divergence_from_main as "Commits Diverged"
FROM v_branch_metrics_latest
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND branch_name != (SELECT default_branch FROM v_repository_team_labels WHERE repo_id = '${repository}')
ORDER BY divergence_from_main DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
  branch_name as "Branch",
  commit_count as "Commits",
  unique_contributors as "Contributors",
  age_days as "Age (Days)",
  staleness_days as "Days Inactive",
  divergence_from_main as "Divergence",
  LEFT(latest_commit_sha, 7) as "Latest Commit"
FROM v_branch_metrics_latest
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
  AND is_active = true
ORDER BY staleness_days ASC;
SELECT language, percentage FROM v_repo_language_distribution_latest WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY percentage DESC;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(summary_text, 'No summary available') as "Summary",
  COALESCE(purpose, '') as "Purpose",
  COALESCE(array_to_string(key_technologies, ', '), '') as "Key Technologies",
  generated_at as "Generated"
FROM repository_summaries
WHERE repo_id = '${repository}'
ORDER BY generated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sha as "SHA", author as "Author", message as "Message", files as "Files", lines_added as "+Lines", lines_removed as "-Lines", commit_date as "Date" FROM v_repo_recent_commits WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' ORDER BY commit_date DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT pr_number as "PR #", title as "Title", author as "Author", source_branch as "Source", target_branch as "Target", size_category as "Size", files_changed as "Files", lines_added as "+Lines", lines_removed as "-Lines", comment_count as "Comments", approval_count as "Approvals", has_issues as "Has Issues", created_at as "Created" FROM v_repo_recent_prs WHERE repo_id = '${repository}' AND status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at DESC;
